content.trans: 但是你这样做是为了你自己。不是因为有人在背后说你是难看。你本身就是难看了。

content.text: That's right. All right. Let's listen to this dialogue one last time and we'll be back in a bit.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请继续提供需要翻译的英文内容。

content.text: Let's go out tomorrow night. We can go to a bar and try to find your girlfriend.
content.trans: 让我们明天晚上出去。我们可以去酒吧找你女朋友。

content.text: I don't think that's a good idea. I'm just not good with approaching someone and starting up a conversation.
content.trans: 我并不认为这是个好主意。我只是不太擅长与人开始对话。

content.text: Maybe you just need a few pickup lines, you know, to break the ice.
content.trans: 英语：也许你只需要几句开场白，就能打破僵局。

content.text: Pick up lines don't work.
content.trans: 拿起线，不工作。

content.text: Come on. You can just walk up to a girl and say, if you were a booger, I'd pick you first.
content.trans: 英语：来吧。你只要走到一个女孩面前，说：“如果你是个屁，我就选你了。”

content.text: What? Come on. That's just lame. No girl would fall for that.
content.trans: 什么？过来吧。那只是可怜的。一个女孩不会喜欢那个。

content.text: Fine. Then you can say, so there you are. I've been looking all over for you. The woman of my dreams.
content.trans: 好的。那么你可以这么说，所以你在这里了。我一直在寻找你。我的梦中的女人。

content.text: That's a good one. I think that's pretty funny.
content.trans: 英语：那是个好点的。我觉得挺有趣的。

content.text: Yeah. So you make her laugh. You make a fool of yourself a little bit and then you buy her a drink.
content.trans: 嗯，你说得对。你让她笑一笑，让你有点尴尬，然后又给她买了一杯酒。

content.text: Okay. How does this sound? I was so enchanted by your beauty that I ran into that wall over there.
content.trans: 好的。你觉得怎么样？我被你的美丽所吸引，差点就撞上了那个墙。

content.text: So I'm going to need your name and number for insurance purposes.
content.trans: 所以，我要你提供我的姓名和号码以便进行保险申请。

content.text: Nice. Let's go.
content.trans: 好的。我们去吧。

content.text: All right. So looking at these pickup lines, we took a look at the first one about the booger and everything.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请继续提供需要翻译的英文内容。

content.text: What about the second one when we say, so there you are. I've been looking all over for you.
content.trans: 英语：当我们说，所以你在这里。我已经找了很久了。

content.text: The woman of my dreams. So what is he saying here? What is implied?
content.trans: 这个女人是我的梦。在这里，他怎么说？隐含的含义是什么？

content.text: He's basically saying that he's met her before and he's been looking for her.
content.trans: 英语：他基本上是在说他已经认识她了，正在寻找她。

content.text: So where did he meet her? He says he met her in his dreams.
content.trans: 所以，他怎么和她相遇的？他说他在梦中遇见了她。

content.text: But now, oh, there she is. I was looking for you. You, you're the woman of my dreams.
content.trans: 但是现在，哦，她在这里。我正寻找你。你是我的梦中的女人。

content.text: Right. So obviously the girl can feel a little bit confused at first because why were you looking for me?
content.trans: 是的。所以很明显，那个女孩一开始会有点儿困惑，因为她为什么找我呢？

content.text: And then he says, oh, because you are the woman of my dreams. So it's obviously a little bit exaggerating, but it's funny.
content.trans: 英语：然后他说，哦，因为你是我梦中的女人。所以显然有点夸张，但很有趣。

content.text: Yes, he's joking, but he's basically saying, you know, I know you. I've been looking for you.
content.trans: 是的，他正经地拍，但基本上是在说，你知道你。我一直在寻找你。

content.text: And what about our last pickup line where he was saying, I was so enchanted by your beauty that I ran into that wall over there.
content.trans: And 什么关于我们上车的最后一句，他说，我被你的美丽所吸引，跑到了那边的那个墙。

content.text: So I am going to need your name and number for insurance purposes.
content.trans: 所以，我需要你的姓名和号码来为保险申请做准备。

content.text: So he's saying, you're so beautiful that I had this accident. I walked into a wall. I hit my face.
content.trans: 所以他说，你这么美以至于我差点摔倒。我走进了一个墙。我撞到了我的脸。

content.text: Now that I have an injury, I need your information so that I can claim insurance.
content.trans: 现在我有伤，需要你的信息以便我可以申请保险。

content.text: So I can get money from my insurance company. So this is a way to ask a woman for her phone number and name at her name exactly.
content.trans: 所以，我可以从我的保险公司获得钱。这就是一个方式，让我向她索要她的电话号码和名字，准确地对应她的姓名。

content.text: So it's a very clever way of obviously breaking the ice, but at the same time he's trying to be funny and trying to get her number, her telephone number and her name.
content.trans: 所以，它显然在故意打破冰，但同时他试图幽默，试图让她号码和名字。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: So one of the most memorable ones that I've heard was was your father a thief because he stole the stars from the sky and put them in your eyes.
content.trans: 所以，我最难忘的一件事就是你父亲是个贼，因为他偷走了天空中的星星，并把它们放在你的眼睛里。

content.text: Nice. So this one is more of a compliment.
content.trans: 好的。这个是更一个赞美。

content.text: Yes, it's a compliment.
content.trans: 是的，这是夸奖。

content.text: But in a funny way saying, oh, your dad stole all the stars from the sky.
content.trans: 但是说，哦，你的爸爸把天空里的星星都偷走了。

content.text: Yeah, no, I've heard a number of them. Most of them are pretty bad, pretty lame.
content.trans: 是的，没有，我听说了几个。大多数都很差，很烂。

content.text: And there's always a way to almost always a way to ask for your phone number.
content.trans: 而且总有办法总是能找到你的电话号码。

content.text: Now, as a girl, what do you think is better for a guy to use a clever, funny, but tasteful pickup line or to just walk up to you and say, hi, my name is so-and-so.
content.trans: 现在，作为一个女孩，你觉得一个聪明、有趣但又不失风度的开场白或者直接走过来和你打招呼更好呢？

content.text: What's your name?
content.trans: 你的名字是什么？

content.text: If you can be clever, if you can come up with something that's funny or interesting, then I think it's good.
content.trans: 如果你能聪明一点，如果你能出一些有趣或有趣的主意，那我觉得这很好。

content.text: If you say something that's rude or disgusting, I think that's probably bad.
content.trans: 如果你说的话是不礼貌或不干净的，我认为这很可能是不好的。

content.text: Like the booger, the booger pickup line is a bad idea.
content.trans: 英语：像猪一样，猪的接吻语是不好的主意。

content.text: That's an example of a bad pickup line.
content.trans: 这个例子是坏的起哄话。

content.text: But you know, if you can laugh about it, not you don't say it seriously, but if you can laugh about it and say, hey, you know, is your daddy a thief?
content.trans: 但是，你说得对。如果你们能笑起来，那就不必太认真了。但如果你们能笑起来并说：“嘿，你爸爸是个小偷吗？”那就更好了。

content.text: It's something to start the conversation if you're laughing.
content.trans: 如果你们在聊天时开怀大笑，那么我建议你先卸下你的责任。

content.text: Because sometimes it's very awkward as someone says, hey, I'm John.
content.trans: 因为有时候说得很尴尬，我叫约翰。

content.text: You know, what's your name?
content.trans: 英语：你知不知道你的名字？

content.text: You don't really know how to react to that.
content.trans: 你并不真正了解如何应对这种情况。

content.text: It's not boring.
content.trans: 英语：它不无聊。

content.text: And approaching someone like that way can be a little bit difficult.
content.trans: 英语：和这样的人接近有点困难。

content.text: Yeah.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: It's a very interesting thing. Let us know if you have any pickup lines.
content.trans: 英语：它是一件非常有趣的事情。让我们知道如果有任何开场白。

content.text: If you've heard any pickup lines or used any, we're really curious to know.
content.trans: 如果你们听过任何开场白或使用过，我们真的很想知道。

content.text: Yeah, our website is englispod.com. We hope to see you guys there.
content.trans: 是的，我们的网站是英语podcast.com。我们希望你们能在这里见到我们。

content.text: Alright guys, bye.
content.trans: 好的，朋友们，再见。
